name: Jump Fuel by jackmojo1
author: jackmojo1
description: This is my submission to the LEGO Ideas One-Button Behavior Bricks Only (no scripting) category. In Jump Fuel, you must collect as many fuel canisters as you can to fuel a rocket bound for the moon. The game features an original score (by me), platforming, puzzle-solving and a real reward if players can find ALL of the fuel canisters before reaching the launch pad.  LEGO Ideas ID: jackmojo1
